frozen_V6_theorem.name: DOUBLE_K5_DEBT_SATURATION
frozen_V6_theorem.statement: If an all-alternate-doors-closed immediate-BVE obstruction exists with exactly six total variables {x}+A, |A|=5, then for every alternate y in A: chi_star(F,y)=5 and every chi witness contains all five variables other than y; independently replayed R47J_y ends nonterminal at width exactly 5 and every widest final clause contains all five variables other than y. Therefore after excluding x, both the CHI_DEBT graph and R47J_DEBT graph on A equal the complete directed graph K5 without self-loops.
proof_basis: R50G11: closed R49H implies chi_star in {5,6}
with V=6, any non-tautological resolvent excluding y contains at most the five other variables, hence chi_star<=5
a non-tautological width-5 union on only five available variables uses all five
R50G5/R50G10: R47J_y removes y, introduces no fresh variables, and closed R47J means nonterminal final width>4
with only five original variables other than y available, final width is exactly 5 and a widest clause uses all five
excluding distinguished x leaves all four other alternates adjacent from y in each debt graph
not_claimed: all-doors-closed obstruction is impossible for V>=7
